earnings_tracker_fields.bmo_amc: Prefer upcoming_earnings_latest.csv column bmo_amc when that file has a value. Else event_time_et on market_calendar_latest.csv (calendar_events.time is that column). before_open -> BMO, after_close -> AMC. all-day and clock times are not a session. earnings_session on ticker_brief_latest.csv is used only when event_time_et is blank and earnings_date matches.
earnings_tracker_fields.expected_beat_miss: Prefer upcoming_earnings_latest.csv column expected_beat_miss. No beat/miss column on the market calendar or the brief. Otherwise null unless notes or catalyst_notes already say expects/expected/consensus beat or miss. A reported EPS beat is result, not this field. expected_impact is not used.
earnings_tracker_fields.guide_risk: Prefer upcoming_earnings_latest.csv column guide_risk. Absent on market_calendar_latest.csv and ticker_brief_latest.csv. Otherwise null unless notes or catalyst_notes already say guide risk, guide cut, guide raise, or guide below/above. No score is computed.
earnings_tracker_fields.other_drivers: upcoming_earnings_latest.csv column other_drivers only. Not on the market calendar or the brief. Null when the file or the cell is missing. News blurbs are not copied into this field.
earnings_tracker_fields.guide_vs_consensus: Prefer upcoming_earnings_latest.csv column guide_vs_consensus. Absent as its own column on the calendar and the brief. Otherwise null unless notes or catalyst_notes already contain a guide clause with exp, consensus, or vs. The clause is copied.
earnings_tracker_fields.actual_estimate_result: No eps_actual, eps_estimate, or beat_miss column. actual and estimate are copied from an EPS vs exp pair in notes or catalyst_notes. result is beat, miss, or inline only by comparing those two numbers. Otherwise null. Scorecard consensus/actual are not read.
earnings_tracker_fields.stock_reaction: No stock_reaction column. Null unless that name's notes or catalyst_notes already contain RH pre ±% or ±% pre.
earnings_tracker_fields.market_reaction: No market_reaction column. Null unless same-day calendar event_name or notes already print QQQ, SPY, NQ, ES, IWM, Nasdaq, S&P, or Dow with a percent.
earnings_tracker_fields.sector_reaction: No sector_reaction column. Null unless same-day calendar event_name or notes already print SMH, XLF, XLE, XLK, XLY, XOP, USO, XLB, or XLI with a percent.
